title: Antlered Mystic on Rift
description: A dark silhouetted figure with long hair stands atop cracked earth, arms raised as colorful glowing rings and sparkling particles emanate from their torso. A large luminous golden stag with antlers formed of swirling smoke and light rises from their head, surrounded by floating lotus flowers against a dark background with smoke and glowing orbs.
prompt: A mystical dark silhouette of a long-haired figure standing on cracked barren ground, arms outstretched as golden, purple and pink glowing rings and sparkling particles flow from their body. A large ethereal golden stag with glowing antlers made of smoke and light emerges from the figure's head, surrounded by floating pink and purple lotus flowers. Swirling white and blue smoke rises from the ground, dramatic dark background with soft glowing orbs, ethereal fantasy style.
